selected_script.angle: Preventing brooms and mops from falling into narrow gaps behind laundry appliances by utilizing vertical wall organization
selected_script.hook: Nothing ruins laundry day like your broom sliding into that narrow, dusty gap behind the dryer.

script_record.video_001_part_01: 0-3s: A close-up of a person struggling to fish out a broom that has slipped and wedged into the tight, dusty gap between a washing machine and the wall. 3-6s: Transition to the light-gray mop holder mounted on the tiled laundry wall. A hand easily pushes the broom handle into a white silicone roller clip where it locks in place. 6-10s: A close-up of a wet mop being pushed into the adjacent clip, holding firmly above the ground.
script_record.video_001_part_02: 10-14s: Shows the organizer holding three long-handled cleaning tools and various spray bottles hanging by their loops from the light-gray J-hooks. 14-18s: Wide shot of a clean, organized laundry room with the floor completely cleared of cleaning clutter. 18-20s: Light CTA text overlay reads 'A simple upgrade for everyday use.'

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video, realistic handheld phone-shot style. 0-3s: Show a real-life frustration of a person struggling to retrieve a broom stuck in the narrow, dusty gap between a washing machine and a wall. 3-6s: Introduce the light-gray organizer with five white silicone rollers and five J-hooks mounted on a laundry wall. A hand pushes the broom handle into a roller clip, locking it securely. 6-10s: Show a wet mop handle being pushed into another clip. Do not include any CTA.

Create a 10-second vertical continuation segment, preserving identical product identity (light-gray plastic housing, white rollers, gray J-hooks) and realistic handheld style. 0-4s: Show a close-up of spray bottles and small brushes hanging from the gray J-hooks on a tiled laundry wall. 4-8s: Zoom out to show the complete horizontal holder organizing multiple brooms and mops, clearing the laundry room floor. 8-10s: Light CTA text overlay: 'A simple upgrade for everyday use.'
